PRINCESS CROAK'S PALACE · PRINCESS CROAK · EVERY UNIT, EVERY DIFFICULTY

What every gnome, fairy, wasp, frog and Princess Croak herself does to your men on EASY, MEDIUM, HARD and MEGA, with every body's HP and head-count · read out of the live game v32.36 on Nov 14, 2026 03:08 EST · every damage number checked on the game's own machines (Chrome 309/309 · WebKit 309/309) · for Raziya

The one thing to know: since v32.27 her harp shot kills: a shot that lands fells any man on foot, whatever his level, and takes half a heavy's bar (the bazooka, the flame and the commando, every machine: two shots; on MEGA a heavy below level 70 falls to one); her tongue's jump-back crit fells every man she licks (every 14 · 11 · 9 · 7 s, the nearest man within 380 px); and her court comes twice (98 · 118 · 272 · 344 bodies in the waves). Sarge and the heroes take her shot as bar hits (2, MEGA 3), and so does every hit of her court: the guard's jab (1), the knight's jab (2), the slinger's glob (1), the wasp's sting (1, and the man is held 2 s), the hornet's sting (3, and he is bowled over), the frog's splat and tongue (1 each), the sage's fire (1 a beat, 10 beats a ring) and his fireball (2 within 60 px), each landing at 50 % on your men (THE DAMPER). No hit is an instant KO (since v29.70): the gnome guard's RAM and her FACE SHOT take 49.5 HP (MEGA 58.5) landing whole, and no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar (he stands on 15 % of it). Her LIGHT ARROWS push every man they cross 220 px west and kill nobody; the sage's toad curse takes Sarge out of the fight for 5 s. Difficulty sets her bar by the designers' time-to-kill chart on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD and the player-damage-threshold pass on MEGA (2,706 · 3,608 · 1,804 · 7,560 with one commander), her lives (1 · 1 · 3 · 3: one full bar on EASY and MEDIUM, three full bars on HARD and MEGA, so 2,706 · 3,608 · 5,412 · 22,680 in all), her cadence, the court's size and HP, and brings the knights, the sages and the hornets.
THE BOSS LAB fights the palace at LEVEL 70 · 77 · 83 · 90 (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA): Sarge with the saber, the scout jeep, the dogfighter, the tank, the bomber and seven men at that rank (rifleman, M. gunner, bazooka, mortar, medic, flame, sweeper). The radio man, grenadier, commando and spy are a tap away in THE PLATOON. Sarge wears the two rank-5 gifts (telekinesis on the saber; the riot shield answers only with the shotgun in hand). Every "level" number on this page is that army.

How a hit is counted

Your men carry HP: the number on their unit sheet (a level-70 flame has 140, a rifleman 33). Their health bar is also cut into a few bar hits (7 for most men at level 70–90, 6 for the medic and spy, 8 for the commando, 12 for the saber Sarge, 23 for the Claymore). Three kinds of hit in this fight:

  • Bar hits (everything the court does, and her harp): a hit of N bar hits lands 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP of N since v28.65, and since v29.17 50 % of that (THE DAMPER, below), so a level-70 rifleman takes 0.92 of his 7 from her harp (4.3 HP of 33) and 0.46 from a guard's jab. Bar hits mend after 4 s without a hit. A hero's bar IS his HP pool (a bar hit lands on it with no share, at the damper's 50 %).
  • THE DAMPER (since v29.17): every blow an enemy lands on your men in the campaign and the boss fights, the Boss Lab included, lands at 50 % of its size; it rides every bar hit on this page, the heroes' too, and every count and level here is counted with it. A KO hit is not dampened: it lands as shipped.
  • No instant KO (since v29.70, Isaac's pass): the guard's ram and her face shot take 49.5 HP (MEGA 58.5) off a man's sheet, landing whole (the damper not taken), as bar hits = that HP × bar ÷ HP; and since v31.00 no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar: the blow that would empty it leaves him on 15 %, the next one fells him. So a level-70 rifleman (33 HP) falls to one ram, a flame (140 HP) to 3 (measured: the first took 2.475 of his 7 bar hits), a pistol Sarge to two (measured: the first left him on 1.65 of 11); the saber turns the ram and the face shot about half the time (measured 14/15 · 12/12 · 11/15 · 12/11 of 16 rams turned per tier, Chrome/WebKit), THE RIOT SHIELD (5 a battle, the shotgun) and the Claymore's counted block (1 a battle: THE DUELIST, every Claymore's default spec) eat them whole (measured: the shotgun Sarge fell to ram 9 · 9 · 10 · 9, the Claymore to ram 3 · 3 · 3 · 3, E · M · H · G); the pet shield, the blue wall and the teal turn the ram; the deflect dome turns her face shot. A jeep or the tank on the guard's spear is still destroyed. Two hits still fell outright: her harp shot on a man on foot (a heavy's second) by her auto attack's law, and her tongue's jump-back crit.
  • No hit: the fairy mends her court and bubbles a guard BIG; the bubble itself pops on a green round; the sage's curse turns Sarge into a toad for 5 s (no fire, no swing).

Saves still roll on every bar hit: a jetting, dropping or dragged man cannot be touched, the pet shield, the deflect dome, the saber Sarge's block turns a bar hit 50 % of the time (measured: 27 of 61, 66 of 125, 10 of 26, 8 of 20 of her shots on the four tiers), the shotgun Sarge's riot shield eats the first 5 hits whole (measured), and the Claymore's counted block eats 1 (measured; THE DUELIST's one block is every Claymore's default spec, the table's 3 only with FEAR or WALL picked). A shot of hers that a save turns takes nothing, her auto attack's law included; the same saves answer the priced ram and face shot (the bite runs the bar hits' door). A charged commando catches a light arrow and sends it back at her.

The bar is 7 for most men from level 70 to 90, so the counts hold across the tiers; HP is what each bar hit is worth. HER HARP SHOT: every man and iron measured on every tier, each to his KO (the dots): a man on foot by her auto attack's law (one shot that lands), a heavy two; Sarge's irons by the arithmetic. The court's hits were measured on a rifleman (jab, glob, sting, frog, fire), a flame (knight, hornet, fire) and a grenadier (fire): each hit's weight on every tier, and the count to the KO (the dot) for the guard's jab, the slinger's glob and the knight's jab; the rest of the column is the same arithmetic. SAGE'S FIRE counts beats in a row; a ring holds 10 (5 s), so a count over 10 means he walks out of the first ring: measured on MEDIUM (level 77), the rifleman with 4.61 of his 7, the flame with 4.53 of his 7, the grenadier with 4.56 of his 7; the 4 s mend gave 1 back before the next ring (12 s on), which KO'd each on its 8th beat (18 beats in all). GNOME RAM and FACE SHOT: the priced bite on every tier (measured on a rifleman, a flame and Sarge's saber, pistol, shotgun and Claymore; the face shot on all four irons; a dot where both engines measured the count to the KO). TONGUE YOINK: measured on a rifleman, a bazooka and a commando on every tier (the dots); every other man by the same crit. SAGE'S FIREBALL: its weight measured on a clump of three men (a fourth 130 px from their middle untouched); the counts are the arithmetic. SARGE · SABER's harp cells carry no dot: 13 · 13 · 13 · 9 is the count if every landed shot came inside the 4 s mend, but his block spaces them and his bar mends between, so the machines measured 34/18 · 59/66 · 16/29 · 12/26 landed shots to his KO (E · M · H · G, Chrome/WebKit, after 147/67 · 252/274 · 47/136 · 40/141 s: at the damper's half his mend nearly keeps pace with her).

A hero's bar is his HP pool: her harp takes 1 (MEGA 1.5) of it a shot: her 2 (MEGA 3) at the damper's 50 %, with no share (measured on every tier). No hero fell inside 60 s on any tier (the damper halves her shot on the pool too). A hero walks, so the count landed in 60 s is the engines' clocks as much as hers: the same on both engines; every shot's weight was the same on both. Her face shot is for a Sarge alone (measured on the Princess Croak hero). The guard's ram and her light arrows go through the same doors for a hero as for a man (the code; not staged on this page).

The level a man first survives

For her harp shot and the hornet's sting. Her auto attack's law: a man on foot survives no shot at any rank; a heavy survives one from rank 0 (on MEGA from 70) and never two; Sarge's rows are the arithmetic. The ram and her face shot: every man but the rifleman survives the first from a full bar (the floor); a rifleman from the rank his HP passes the bite (never on EASY to HARD, never on MEGA). No man survives the jump-back crit. Green = he already does at the lab's EASY level 70; — = not even at rank 100.

HARP SHOTa man on foot: KO · a heavy: 2 · every 2.4 sa man on foot: KO · a heavy: 2 · every 2 sa man on foot: KO · a heavy: 2 · every 1.8 sa man on foot: KO · a heavy: 2 · every 2 s (below level 70: KO)HER AUTO ATTACK KILLS (since v32.27): the nearest man within 400 px (a jetting, cloaked or dragged man is not picked); a shot that LANDS takes at least his whole bar from a man on foot, so he falls to the first whatever his level, and half a heavy's (the bazooka, the flame and the commando, every machine), so he falls to the second; on MEGA a heavy below level 70 falls to the first. She opens on her top step; her court walks on behind her over the first seconds. A wave holds while her court stands, then comes when her bar falls to its mark, or after the idle clock with her court down (since v31.39); THE COURT RETURNS come on her bar too. Every count here is twice the old row (since v32.27): the sheet as the lab fields it.

How this was read and checked

The live client v32.36 (index.html md5 055c105b750dc1652be801b7b4e14f9f, the Big Mac's main at the time of this read, which carries CARD-PCH) was opened headless on Maker 1 and read with the game's own functions, THE DAMPER's table by name among them: every table, every tier's wave sheet, a real lab fight per tier for the stock army and its level, every man's HP and bar at every rank, her bar for 1 to 10 commanders. Then each hit was measured on the real machines in a BOSS LAB fight on every tier, every attacker born through the palace's own wave row so the tier's stamps ride: THE DAMPER in every lab fight (the game's own share on each tier equals its cell, and every hit on our men rode it); her harp shot on all eleven men and Sarge's five irons, each to his KO, and on the six heroes for 60 s; her auto attack by level (a heavy at 69 and 70, a flame at 0, a commando and a rifleman at 100, a medic at 1); her tongue's jump-back crit on a rifleman, a bazooka and a commando (and that a Sarge in reach is never licked); her face shot on a saber and a pistol Sarge (and that a rifleman, a hero and a Sarge at 100 px are spared); her light arrows with the wave her half bar releases, on three men on her three lines, a jeep in the middle and a medic clear of them (the push), the commando's catch and the ray thrown back at her and her gnome, MEGA's second volley; the opening court as the lab fields it (twice the sheet's old rows); the sage's fireball on a clump; the guard's jab and ram (and the scout jeep, the V2 jeep and the tank on the spear), the knight's jab and shield, the guard's shield and armour under our rifle, the slinger's glob, the sage's toad curse and fire, the fairy's mend and bubble, the wasp's sting and the hold, the hornet's sting and the bowl-over, the frog's splat and tongue; on HARD and MEGA her retreat, THE BUBBLE COURT, the big guards' charge, the bar clock and the second zero; every body as the tier bears it. Chrome 309/309 · WebKit 309/309 checks passed, zero page errors. The two engines' READS are identical (checked), and every damage fact in the two proofs agrees (1560 facts checked across the engines: each hit's weight, every KO and every save, every body). What differs between Chrome and WebKit is dice and clocks, and this page prints both where it matters: the saber Sarge's harp shots landed to his KO (34/18 · 59/66 · 16/29 · 12/26 on E · M · H · G, after 147/67 · 252/274 · 47/136 · 40/141 s); the gnome's ram on 16 fresh saber Sarges (0/0 · 0/0 · 0/0 · 0/0 KO'd); the frame a hit lands on, and the slinger's wander.
